reason: E1 directly supports that SRO makes the alloy stiffer and harder, increases plastic zone size, and suppresses twinning, but neither E1 nor E2 provides evidence on thermal expansion anisotropy, yield strength increase percentages, or behavior at elevated temperatures up to 1073 K. The cited evidence is accurately represented for the premises it covers, but several key premises lack support.
premises: SRO makes HfNbTaTiZr both stiffer and harder
SRO increases the size of the plastic zone and dislocation density
SRO suppresses twinning plasticity compared to random alloy
SRO can be induced by thermal processing (annealing/slow cooling)
SRO effects persist and influence mechanical behavior at elevated temperatures
